{{Quote|We're on our way to Coruscant, the central system in the Republic, on a very important mission.|[[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] to a young [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
The '''Coruscant system''', later called the '''Imperial system'''<ref name="Dark Empire endnotes">[[Dark Empire endnotes|''Dark Empire'' endnotes]]</ref> and during [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] '''Yuuzhan'tar system''',<ref name="The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref> was an eleven-planet system that contained the star [[Coruscant Prime/Legends|Coruscant Prime]] and the galactic capital world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
This system was vulnerable to meteor showers. One of them, dated some time before [[3956 BBY]] caused the loss of an orbital station. Another shower occurred soon after.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

The outlying moons of this system were used for storage of garbage canisters transported there from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Rogue Planet">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were trained on one of the system's inner worlds, [[Vandor-3]].<ref name="Cestus Deception">''[[The Cestus Deception]]''</ref>

[[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggling]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] in the Coruscant system was considered to be a capital offense.<ref name="FTS">{{JournalCite|2|The Free-Trader's Guide to Sevarcos}}</ref>
